title: fix(ui): close stuck submenus when moving between menu rows
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the stuck highlight and assignee submenu when the mouse moves from a tall user list onto another parent-menu row.

## User Impact

Sidebar and chat-header menus now close the old submenu and highlight the row under the pointer. Moving across another parent row deliberately targets that row instead of preserving the previous branch through an invisible hover corridor. Direct submenu entry, paced edge-to-choice diagonal movement, and keyboard selection remain covered.

## Why This Change Was Made

Disable hit testing only on the shared submenu safe-triangle pseudo-element. The submenu itself stays interactive, and Web Awesome remains the single owner of visibility, focus, closing grace, and branch retirement. No dependency patch or second hover controller is added.

## Evidence

- Required **openclaw/ci-gate passed** for exact head `addbd9f07ba46a12475fb5bc1d4b6f80df010756` in [CI run 35410776426](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35410776426).
- All **10 real-Chromium E2E tests** pass, including sidebar/header row retirement, visible hover color, submenu replacement, paced diagonal entry and the resulting owner-assignment request, plus existing keyboard, compact-layout, and error cases. Gateway data is synthetic.
- The same fixture with only the production CSS change removed fails at the original defect: **Assign to… remains expanded after moving onto Fork conversation**.
- Focused UI E2E and UI production typechecks, formatting, stylelint, oxlint, and `git diff --check` pass.
- AutoReview completed with **no actionable P0–P2 findings** on this change.
- Inspected before/after screenshots from the same synthetic fixture are embedded below and have also been delivered in the originating conversation.

The full 20-partition core-test typecheck sweep was intentionally stopped in favor of the relevant UI test graph and UI production types; it is not claimed as passing. Non-Chromium engines are not claimed as tested.

Review disposition: [ClawSweeper found no actionable correctness or security defects](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/152317#issuecomment-5738056313). Its remaining concern is Chromium-only browser proof. This is retained as a verification limitation, not an additional merge gate: the fix changes only pseudo-element hit testing, while the existing dropdown owner keeps visibility, keyboard navigation, and pointer-exit grace. The ten Chromium cases cover those affected interactions; Firefox/WebKit behavior is not claimed.

<details>
<summary>Focused verification commands</summary>

`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/session-owner-assignment.e2e.test.ts` — 10 passed.

`node scripts/run-tsgo-core-test-shards.mjs --changed-paths-json '["ui/src/e2e/session-owner-assignment.e2e.test.ts"]' --concurrency 4` — selected UI E2E graph, passed.

`node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.ui.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/ui.tsbuildinfo` — passed.

</details>
